City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 15, 2023 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS- NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 18, 2023, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2023-11-15 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2023-11-15 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Authorization to enter into a Professional Services Agreement with HOCH Consulting to provide Professional Consulting Services for Asbestos Cement Main Condition Assessment and Replacement Master Plan. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board of Directors is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Hariri
Authorize the General Manager to execute an agreement with HOCH Consulting in substantial form, in consultation with the Agency Attorney, in the amount of $200,000 for Fiscal Year 2023-24 and $129,945 for Fiscal Year 2024-2025 which includes 10 percent contingency and $9,185 in optional services. Total agreement amount not-to-exceed is $329,945 without additional authorization.
2023-11-15 SDWD Item S08D AC Pipe Condition Assessment
8E.
Award Construction Contract for the Air Release and Blow-off Replacement Project Phase I. Environmental Considerations: It has been determined that the proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301 (c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. The Project is a water maintenance project and therefore, meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Hariri
1) Authorize the General Manager to execute a contract in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extensions in consultation with the Agency Attorney, with M-Rae Engineering, Inc., in the amount of $908,700, plus a 15 percent contingency ($136,305) for a total not-to-exceed construction contract amount of $1,045,005 including any future contract amendments for construction of the Air Release and Blow-off Replacement Project Phase I (CW23X); and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2023-15, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Budget" to amend the FY 2023-24 budget by transferring $1,045,005 from Project No. CW23D, Water Transmission Line Maintenance, to fund Project No. CW23X, Air Release and Blow-off Replacement Project Phase I.
2023-11-15 SDWD Item S08E Air Release and Blowoff Replacement Project Phase I
8F.
Agreement between San Elijo Joint Powers Authority and San Dieguito Water District Regarding the Provision of Recycled Water to the Encinitas Ranch Golf Authority. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
District Board authorize the General Manager, in consultation with the General Counsel, to execute the Agreement in substantial form between San Elijo Joint Powers Authority and San Dieguito Water District.
2023-11-15 SDWD Item S08F SEJPA-SDWD Agreement
8G.
Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) - Participation in Regionwide Water Conservation Program. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Water Resource Specialist Han
1) Execute the Memorandum of Understanding with the San Diego County Water Authority; and 2) Accept reimbursed expenses through the program for up to $15,000.
2023-11-15 SDWD Item S08G MOU Regionwide Water Conservation Program
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
10A.
Proposed allocation of the $50,000 contribution from Nolen Communities LLC/ Shea Homes KP, a voluntary benefit associated with the Fox Point Farms residential development (SDWD Resolution: 2023-13). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Water Resource Specialist Han
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2023-18, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Budget" to appropriate $50,000 to the water conservation budget; 2) Review proposed allocation for rain barrels and flow monitoring devices; 3) Consider other options for the allocation of funds; and 4) Provide direction regarding use of funds.
2023-11-15 SDWD Item S10A Proposed allocation of the $50,000 contribution from Nolen Communities LLC Shea Homes KP
10B.
Consideration of revisions to the City of Encinitas/San Dieguito Water District's Compensation Policy Number C013 and approval of Districts Titles and Salary Schedule for Fiscal Year 2023-24. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the District Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Persons: Assistant City Manager Campbell and Interim Director of Human Resources Schwarm
1) Adopt Resolution 2023-16, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District amending the City of Encinitas/San Dieguito Water District's Compensation Policy C013;" and 2) Adopt Resolution 2023-17, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District approving Titles and Pay Ranges for Fiscal Year 2023-24."
2023-11-15 SDWD Item S10B Compensation Policy
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS – NONE
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON DECEMBER 20, 2023
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
